item.title: Street Lighting Out of Service on Avonmouth Street, 18th September
item.description:
Good evening, Two of the four street lamps on the section of Avonmouth Street leading from Borough High Street are currently out of service. This makes the journey particularly unsafe for students, especially female students, living at the Your Tribe Elephant & Castle student residence, which is located on the corner of this street. Could you please arrange for this issue to be resolved as soon as possible? Thank you in advance for your assistance. Kind regards,

item.title: Light brightness, 18th September
item.description:
Hi My son has recently been diagnosed with epilepsy and has suffered a couple of attacked in the evening / night. After months of looking into why we have had the street lamp opposite our property as the issue. Whilst we have blinds on the windows the light is bright and does cause the room to get lighter . This has triggered the episodes specially as a child sleeps they can blink and allow the light into the retina. I was looking for if missing the lamp, disabling it or getting it dimmer could be an option ? Thanks Kev
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Westfield Road, Barnehurst, Greater London

item.title: Rubbish dumped by developers., 18th September
item.description:
The development of number 25 had been going on for some time, but the developer seems to treat our road with utter contempt. Each weak there is a new collection of rubbish stacked outside, which is an eyesore and also a safety concern as there are no pavements in Holbrook Lane, so pedestrians have to walk in the road. I appreciate there needs to be commercial vehicles present when building works take place, but there is no excuse for a rubbish pile that blocks the road.
